context.summary: Found while drafting the T-skills and T-reconcile briefs. Both are next in spine §8 step 3 and have no open blockers, but their TaskDrafted events (imported 2026-11-19) carry empty repo/branch/worktree, so status stays `approved` instead of `ready`, and a dispatcher could never start them. Work can proceed meanwhile: the briefs name the branch and worktree in prose. Until decided, the registry shows the fields empty.

options.tradeoff: New orchestrator-lane event TaskUpdated (repo, base_branch, branch, worktree, title, tier_grants) allowed only before approval, plus `ekumen task update`. Small; needs C-event-log and C-cli-json versions.
Allow `task draft` on an id whose task is unapproved; the newer TaskDrafted replaces fields. No new event type, but bends 'first draft wins' and the id-collision rule.
Defer the placeholders and draft new tasks with new ids. No code change; churns ids that the spine, decisions and graph already use.

data.question: T-skills, T-reconcile, T-claude-adapter, T-server, T-graph-view and T-decision-views were imported as drafts with empty repo, base_branch, branch and worktree. `task draft` refuses an id already in use, and no command sets these fields, so these tasks can be approved but never derive `ready`. How should the orchestrator fill them?
data.title: How do imported placeholder tasks get a repo, branch and worktree
